verdict.rationale: Composio explicitly ships a hosted official MCP server (Composio Connect at https://connect.composio.dev/mcp) plus session-based MCP opt-in (mcp: true), documented with concrete setup and tool schemas across multiple docs pages and a probe confirming the endpoint. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the MCP connection itself (the community evidence found relates to Instagram auth and a leaked key, not MCP connectivity).
